algorithm: average-reward tabular Q-learning (SMART rho, RVI anchoring; epsilon-greedy, experience replay)

state_space.k=0: (task, draft lag 0/1/2+, previous cycle: none or all/rej x length 1/2/3+)
state_space.k>=1: (task, k, cumulative draft-confidence bin, previous cycle)

action_space: STOP (verify now) or DRAFT one more token
reward: tokens emitted - rho * modeled seconds of the decision; rho = running throughput of greedy cycles; token cap treated as truncation
